messages.content: 你能給我盧浮宮博物館未來3個月的展覽資訊嗎？然後告訴我巴黎地區最好的意式和中式餐廳嗎？

function.name: restaurant_info
function.description: Get restaurant information for a specific area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: Location for which to find restaurants.

food_type.description: Type of cuisine for which to find restaurants. Default is 'all' if not specified.

function.name: exhibition_info
function.description: Get exhibition information for a specific museum. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

museum_name.description: Name of the museum for which to find exhibitions.

month.description: Number of upcoming months for which to retrieve exhibition details. Default is 1 if not specified.

1. Exhibition info for Louvre Museum for next 3 months. Use function exhibition_info with museum_name="盧浮宮博物館" and month=3.

2. Restaurant info for Paris region for Italian and Chinese cuisine. Use function restaurant_info twice: location="巴黎地區", food_type="Italian" and location="巴黎地區", food_type="Chinese".

We need to call the functions. The user didn't specify a location for restaurants beyond "巴黎地區". So we can use that. The function expects location string. We can pass "巴黎" or "巴黎地區". Let's use "巴黎" as location. The user asked for "巴黎地區最好的意式和中式餐廳". So we can pass location="巴黎" and food_type accordingly.

We need to call the functions. The user wants both. We can call them sequentially. The system might want us to call them in order. We'll call exhibition_info first, then restaurant_info twice.
